instagram.caption:
The good towels you never use.
The Linen and Towel Storage in the Primary Bathroom. To hold enough clean towels for the way this house actually does laundry, and no more than the shelf can safely carry.

What done looks like:
1. Three bath towels per person
2. One in use
3. One in the wash
4. One folded on the shelf. Each guest set nested in its own pillowcase

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success linen and towel storage.
